note: GRIME region 'Houston' — real-data pipeline (DEM→streams→candidates→stream mask (sites confined to ±150 m of mapped OSM/NHD waterways)→region-appropriate real parameters→shipped scoring, math unchanged). Width curve: Bieger et al. 2015 JAWRA Table 3, Atlantic Plain. Flood: not applicable here (documented fallback). Low-gradient bayous; tidal lower reaches

beach_dist_km.source: haversine to region ref: Galveston Island beach

channel_width_score.source: Bieger 2015 APL width curve on DEM drainage area → shipped width curve

cso_density.source: EPA ECHO CSO inventory (national bulk), Cauchy proximity

ej_index.source: Census ACS C17002+B03002 two-component demographic index, percentile-ranked within region

estuary_dist_km.source: haversine to region ref: Upper Galveston Bay

flood_q10_cfs.source: flood regression not valid here (Low-gradient bayous; tidal lower reaches...) — NaN, dropped by constant-column handling

flow_velocity_ms.source: Manning (region DEM/D8) blended with EROM continuity (shipped M4 logic)

land_ownership.source: no parcel integration outside NC (statewide layer is NC OneMap) — unknown 0.5

litter_complaint_density.source: no machine-readable 311/litter source for this region

navigable_dist_m.source: USACE/BTS NWN (NTAD): no navigable segment within this bbox (+2 km) — computed absence, gate passes all sites

npdes_points.source: EPA ECHO NPDES outfalls (national bulk), per catchment

population_density.source: Census ACS 2022 B01003 block groups (bbox, multi-county), area-weighted

protected_area_score.source: no local PAD-US 4.1 clip for this state (NC-only download)

road_density_km_km2.source: OSM drive network (osmnx, cached) clipped per catchment

seasonal_cv.source: CV of NHDPlus EROM monthly flows per COMID

superfund_score.source: EPA Envirofacts SEMS state=TX (sign-fixed, georeferenced sites), shipped 500 m inverse-distance curve

tourism_amenity_density.source: OSM leisure/tourism features per 2 km radius

tri_facility_density.source: EPA Envirofacts TRI state=TX (sign-fixed), per catchment

velocity_feasibility.source: shipped step curve on the computed velocity

velocity_transport_favorability.source: scored form of flow_velocity_ms inside the Flow family — peaked Gaussian exp(-((v-0.9)/0.6)^2), model.json curves.velocity_transport_favorability; construct: transport/delivery favorability, deliberately distinct from velocity_feasibility (device operability)

water_intake_score.source: no public surface-intake layer wired outside NC (SWAP layer is NC-only)

width_curve.source: Bieger et al. 2015 JAWRA Table 3, Atlantic Plain
